name: DNS Resolve
description: This module allows you to resolve a hostname into its corresponding IP addresses using DNS. It queries standard DNS records (IPv4 A and IPv6 AAAA) to help verify name resolution, test connectivity, and troubleshoot DNS-related issues quickly without requiring administrative privileges.
